name: Date Property Backlinks
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Adds one-time daily template setup, automatic daily views, pane-local dates and matching labels.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Set up your daily note template once, or let existing daily notes show matching notes with no embed.
Each pane uses the date of its own daily note, so split panes can show different days.
tip: A list date property matches when any date in the list falls on the daily note date.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Date Property Backlinks is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it with your daily notes.
